information: **Welcome to FMC Asia 2025, the first FMC simultaneous competition in Asia since 2020!** This competition will take place across multiple locations in Asia. Please pay close attention to the **date and time zone** of your location! To view the full list of locations, please check the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCAsia2025#59379-locations). The location adding period ended on July 11th at 23:59 UTC, and locations cannot be added under any circumstances. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
